description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces and functions for interacting with a chat API backend, including sending messages, fetching messages, creating conversations, and retrieving conversations.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message to the backend API.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Fetches messages for a specific conversation from the backend API.

methods.name: createConversation
methods.description: Creates a new conversation via the backend API.

methods.name: getConversations
methods.description: Retrieves conversations for a specific user from the backend API.
